title: entry.publish, contract version 1
description: Publishes an entry (PRD 6.4) in one changeset: it releases a revision of the entry's shared variant and puts its home placement live in one locale, now or in a window. A type with stages none has no revision to release, so its revision is null. A variant or a placement at another version than the caller read is version_conflict. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Publishing\Domain\Commands\PublishEntry, and the generated codec PublishEntryCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

locale.description: The locale the placement goes live in.

placement.description: The id of the entry's home placement, a placement below its home node.

placement_version.description: The version of the home placement the caller read.

revision.description: The number of the revision to release, an integer of 1 or more, or null for a type with stages none.

version.description: The version of the entry's shared variant the caller read.

window.description: The window the placement is live in, or null or missing to put it live from now.

locale.description: A language tag of a language, an optional script and an optional region, such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS; the kernel writes the language in lowercase, the script in title case and the region in uppercase.

time_window.description: When a placement is live: from live_from, inclusive, until live_until, exclusive, each RFC 3339 with an offset, stored in UTC. A null or missing live_from is since always, and a null or missing live_until for ever; live_from is before live_until.

live_from.description: When the placement goes live, RFC 3339 with an offset, or null for since always.

live_until.description: When the placement stops being live, RFC 3339 with an offset, or null for ever.

version.description: The version of an aggregate that the caller read, an integer of 1 or more; the command is version_conflict when the aggregate is at another version when it commits.
